subject: A small clarification about the room
text:
Hi,

Sorry for the extra email. I keep thinking about what I wrote earlier, and I realized my first note may have sounded a little too direct. When I asked for one community room, I meant a flexible space, not necessarily the big room by the park. That room has been popular with several local groups lately, so I do not want to create a mix-up during your very first week.

I had a quieter idea. What if we used the community room above the library instead? It holds about twelve chairs, has better natural light, and is easier to reach if people have strollers. It also faces the garden, which felt nice when I visited yesterday. If we could set up a few movable tables and two charging outlets near the wall, it would work well for the intro session. I know this differs from the original plan, so I am happy to help move chairs beforehand. I can also bring the handouts and a small box of markers, since those often get lost when people rush.

I do not want you to feel pressured. I just want the event to be warm and practical. If the alternative room feels too small, then the park room is still fine. I only thought the library room might feel less formal for newcomers. Let me know what seems easiest, and I can adjust the wording on our flyer so people are not surprised when they arrive.

Thanks for being patient while I sort out the details. I think the session will go well once we settle the room question. I appreciate you helping us make the community feel welcomed and comfortable.
